# CODEMAP - generated by `tools/codemap.py`, do not hand-edit

over reading a whole file (hero3d.gd is ~26k tokens). Regenerate after moving
functions: `py tools\codemap.py`. Constants are listed by name only; grep
`^const` for their values, or `^var` for mutable state.
